## Be of the Cyborg race

Only players this chapter belongs to can make progress in it.

Be of the Cyborg race.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be of the Cyborg race

<a id="q-3c81df60d1b563e5"></a>

## Cola-Powered

Franky rebuilt himself from scrap after a train hit him, and runs on cola ever since.

Be a Cyborg and carry three bottles of cola.

A cyborg starts bare. Open your Body (the cyborg's own technique) to fit parts: a head, a right arm, a chest, legs and shoulders from the start, a left arm at 25,000 Doriki, and accessory slots as your Doriki grows. Every part brings its own moves and strength. Cola Fuel comes with the race.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Be of the Cyborg race](r_cyborg.md#q-2693879283fca6f8)

**Tasks**

- Carry 3 cola

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +2 Training Points (your race)

<a id="q-2b8666bfabb3202c"></a>

## Your First Part

Every cyborg starts the same way: one part, fitted by hand, that works better than the flesh it replaced.

Fit a part to any of your body slots (head, arms, chest, legs or shoulders). From here every body part is its own road: take them in any order, at any pace.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Cola-Powered](r_cyborg.md#q-3c81df60d1b563e5)

**Tasks**

- Fit any body part

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +3 Training Points (your race)

<a id="q-691bf13b06754a34"></a>

## Future Land Baldimore

Vegapunk's old laboratory on the winter island of Baldimore still holds plans no shipwright has seen.

Visit ruins in Paradise and learn a part's plan (Vegapunk Arms or Rocket Shoulders).

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Your First Part](r_cyborg.md#q-2b8666bfabb3202c)

**Tasks**

- Visit ruins in Paradise
- Know the plan for Vegapunk Arms or Rocket Shoulders

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500, +4 Training Points (your race)

<a id="q-21ca264e2d6aa593"></a>

## Spare Parts

A cola tank, back plating, a head lamp, a skywalk kit: the small things that make a cyborg comfortable.

Fit an accessory. The first accessory slot is open from the start; the others open at 10,000, 20,000, 30,000 and 40,000 Doriki.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Your First Part](r_cyborg.md#q-2b8666bfabb3202c)

**Tasks**

- Fit an accessory

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +1 Training Points (your race)

<a id="q-317665a971d35946"></a>

## Netherite Frame

Head to toe, nothing of the old body is left that a cannonball could break.

Have Netherite parts on all six body slots: head, both arms, chest, legs and shoulders.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Head: Netherite](r_cyborg.md#q-42156d9a8708972f), [Right Arm: Netherite](r_cyborg.md#q-581afcfd712de2f4), [Left Arm: Netherite](r_cyborg.md#q-2f3b9808047f18d8), [Chest: Netherite](r_cyborg.md#q-4574b2fbbaa5e3b1), [Legs: Netherite](r_cyborg.md#q-657bbf5b088d4933), [Shoulders: Netherite](r_cyborg.md#q-18089500ba688bf3)

**Tasks**

- Netherite parts on all six body slots

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +42,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +4 Training Points (your race)

## Egghead's Genius

On Egghead, the future island, Vegapunk builds what the rest of the world will have in five hundred years. Bring him something worth looking at.

Visit ruins in the New World, carry a Netherite Vegapunk Arms or Rocket Shoulders, and fill all five accessory slots.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Netherite Frame](r_cyborg.md#q-6313970efce096fb), [Fully Kitted](r_cyborg.md#q-60eb6f82614edb92)

**Tasks**

- Visit ruins in the New World
- Netherite Vegapunk Arms or Rocket Shoulders
- Fit 5 accessories

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +100,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +6 Training Points (your race)
